title: Property, Plant and Equipment
summary: Prescribes the recognition, measurement, depreciation and revaluation of property, plant and equipment, converged with IAS 16, with a genuine Indian interaction: Schedule II's prescribed indicative useful lives.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Converged with IAS 16, with a Genuine Useful Life Interaction
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 16's recognition, measurement, and revaluation model mirrors IAS 16 closely. The distinctive Indian feature is Schedule II of the Companies Act, 2013, which PRESCRIBES indicative useful lives for common asset classes – a level of prescriptive guidance IAS 16 deliberately avoids globally. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
